## Derivative coverage (the v2 focus)

v1 parameterised only equities / fixed income / listed futures; the four derivative classes existed solely as four hand-authored representative cases. v2 brings them to 110 cases with sub-type diversity:

- **Interest rate swaps (30):** USD SOFR, EUR ESTR/EURIBOR, GBP SONIA across 2Y/5Y/7Y/10Y/30Y tenors. Breaks include fixed-rate, notional, effective-date, counterparty/legal-entity, and convention (day-count, payment frequency, floating index/basis).
- **FX forwards (35):** deliverable majors and crosses plus non-deliverable forwards (USD/INR, USD/KRW, USD/BRL). Breaks include forward-rate (pip-scaled per quote convention), per-leg SSI, currency (wrong cross), value-date, and notional.
- **Credit (20):** single-name IG and HY plus index (CDX.IG, CDX.HY, iTraxx Main). Breaks include spread, running-coupon and restructuring-clause conventions, notional, counterparty, and spread+restructuring multi-exception.
- **Options (25):** listed equity/ETF (American) and index (SPX, European), calls and puts. Breaks include premium, contract count, commission (per-contract), exercise-style convention, and expiry/settlement date.

Convention/term mismatches map to `EXC-PROD` (product/term classification) with the specific broken term named in `reviewer_notes`; cross-currency errors map to `EXC-CCY`.
